name: outreach-engine
description: Domain-agnostic enterprise outreach engine. Takes a product brief plus an ICP and produces a complete cold-to-signed campaign package  --  ranked targets with fit scoring, per-target deep intelligence, named decision-maker contacts, multi-touch send packs with cadence, archetype one-pagers, meeting simulations, and a master execution playbook. Works for IP licensing, SaaS sales, partnerships, fundraising, services. Vertical specifics are passed in via inputs; the engine itself contains no domain hardcoding.

related_flows.description: outputs archetype_pack_registry, target_intel_registry consumed by pricing-model-writer
